rows.title: The live animals list is reframed in place, scoped to the trader's organisation, and plants' list takes the same frame
rows.detail: The live animals notification list stays at the live-animals set root in the animals frontend and is reframed there to Design Release 2.1's category list: a 'Dashboard' title and caption, the category as its heading, a 'Create new' button straight under the heading in place of the start button, the cards under 'Notifications' and each card named for screen readers. The list shows only the signed-in trader's organisation's notifications, because today the animals backend serves every trader's notifications to every caller. Plants' own list takes the same frame in the same increment (9 October afternoon ruling), keeping its own first page. Every new string has a Welsh machine draft, and the k6 journey keeps working against the reframed list.
acceptanceCriteria: A signed-in trader opening the live animals list at the live-animals set root sees the browser title 'Dashboard - Import notification service - GOV.UK', the caption 'Dashboard' and the h1 'Live animals'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-021, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-100; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-032, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-033; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-038; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-002, repo-frontend-p3-003; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-086)

On the live animals list the heading is followed directly by a primary 'Create new' button: there is no introductory paragraph, no Messages link and no 'Start a new notification' button. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-038-m1, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-040; prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-022; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-004, repo-frontend-p3-005; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-087)

Pressing 'Create new' on the live animals list starts a new live animals notification with status Draft in the live-animals set and lands on that set's first journey page, with or without JavaScript; opening or reloading the list creates no draft. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-022; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-006, repo-frontend-p3-106; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-102; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-087; conflict c-251)

On the live animals list and on plants' list the notification cards sit under the h2 'Notifications'; the h2 'Your notifications' is gone from both lists. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-026; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-045; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-008; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-013; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-088, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-096)

Each card on the live animals list and on plants' list has the notification's reference as its h3 and is announced to screen readers as 'Notification <reference>'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-046; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-064, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-122; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-037; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-039; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-088, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-096)

Signed in for one organisation, a trader sees only that organisation's notifications on the live animals list: a notification started under another organisation never appears, not even when its reference is searched. The animals backend's list answers a request that does not say which organisation it acts for with a refusal, not a list. (ruling:sam-2026-10-07 ruling-sam-2026-10-07-p1-010; repo:backend repo-backend-p3-003; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-137; trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p2-091; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p3-095)

Plants' notification list has the browser title 'Dashboard - Import notification service - GOV.UK' and the caption 'Dashboard' above its h1. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-021, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-100; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-001, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-002; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-067, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-096)

Plants' list's h1 reads 'Plants', following the default of c-303. (repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-002, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-003; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-096; conflict c-303)

Plants' list has no introductory paragraph: its heading is followed directly by a primary 'Create new' button in place of 'Start a new notification', and pressing it starts a high-risk plants notification and lands on its commodity type page, as today. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-022; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-004, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-008, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-010, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-011, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-012; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-087, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-096)

With Welsh chosen, every new or changed string on the live animals list and on plants' list shows its Welsh version, and each new Welsh string is marked as a machine draft that ships only once a translator signs it off under the Welsh Language Standards. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-068, repo-frontend-p3-069; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-006, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-007, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-050)

The k6 journey run against the stack still opens the live animals list at the live-animals set root for the crumb it posts back, creates a notification, searches the list for it by reference and finds the submitted notification's reference on the list, passing every check. (repo:perftests repo-perftests-p1-005, repo-perftests-p1-068, repo-perftests-p1-069; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-089; conflict c-225)

rows.title: Notification cards show Design Release 2.1's facts, on the live animals list and on plants' list
rows.detail: The card leads with what is coming, when, to whom and its status. A live animals card shows its facts in two rows, with the quantity as 'Number of animals' from the animals backend's record and the commodity as the trader chose it. It shows no 'Date created' or 'Date submitted', writes the arrival date with the full month name and shows 'Not applicable' rather than a blank fact. Plants' card takes the same layout with plants' own facts, as the afternoon ruling says.
acceptanceCriteria: A live animals card shows its facts in two rows: 'Commodity', 'Arrival date', 'Consignee' and 'Notification status', then 'Number of animals', 'Origin' and 'Consignor'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-053, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-054; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-065, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-070; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-038; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-090; conflict c-167)

A live animals card's 'Number of animals' shows the notification's own count of animals from its record. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-054; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-082; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-090)

A live animals card's 'Commodity' is the notification's commodity name as the trader chose it, so a commodity chosen as Bos taurus shows 'Bos taurus', not 'Cow'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-056; repo:backend repo-backend-p3-015; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-039; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p3-024)

The card labels the arrival date 'Arrival date' and the status 'Notification status', on the live animals list and on plants' list. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-053; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-065; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-038; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-040; conflict c-167)

The card writes the arrival date as the day, the full month name and the year, such as '21 June 2026', on the live animals list and on plants' list. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-066; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-046; trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p2-031; conflict c-164)

No card shows 'Date created' or 'Date submitted', on the live animals list or on plants' list. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-102; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-042, repo-frontend-p3-044; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-048; conflict c-167)

A card whose notification has no commodity, no arrival date or no quantity yet shows 'Not applicable' for that fact instead of a blank value, on the live animals list and on plants' list. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-056, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-058, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-101; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-039, repo-frontend-p3-043; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-044)

Plants' card shows 'Commodity', 'Arrival date' and 'Notification status' in its first row, with the 'Late' tag beside the status when the notification is late, then 'Origin' and 'Consignor'; it shows no Consignee and no quantity. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-053, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-054; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-040, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-041, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-047; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-096, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-098)

The 'Inspection' fact (req-1083) waits in the blocked outcomes row, so the second row shows it only once the authorities' outcomes reach the record.

rows.title: Card status styles: 'Draft' and 'Action required' tags, 'Submitted' as plain text, on both lists
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 uses a tag only for statuses that ask something of the trader. A draft shows a 'Draft' tag and an action-required notification an 'Action required' tag, while 'Submitted' is plain styled text. Plants' card follows the same styles for Draft and Submitted and keeps its 'Late' tag; 'Action required' is animals only, because it rests on the health certificate.
acceptanceCriteria: On the live animals list a draft's 'Notification status' is a 'Draft' tag. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-061, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-062; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-067; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-046; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-090)

On the live animals list a notification the animals backend records as action required shows the status as an 'Action required' tag. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-063; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-068; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-091, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-076)

On the live animals list a submitted notification's status 'Submitted' is plain styled text, not a tag. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-061; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-067; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p3-029, trace-e2e-p3-030)

On plants' list a draft's status is a 'Draft' tag, a submitted notification's 'Submitted' is plain styled text, and a late notification keeps its 'Late' tag beside the status. (repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-049-m1; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-076; conflict c-301)
notes: New row: req-1079 was in inc-130. Split out so the card facts and every list row after them build now; only this row waits on inc-113, which records 'Submitted action required' (overview-and-review theme).

Overlap for the combiner: inc-131 (req-939) shows 'Action required' on the card for a notification missing its health certificate, from inc-113's status. That is the same card change on the same set-up; merge this row into inc-131, or keep inc-131 after this row with only its own wording.
An amending notification keeps today's yellow 'Amending' tag (req-1060, tabs row). The 'Completed' style (req-1739) waits in the blocked outcomes row.

rows.title: The live animals list has 'In progress', 'Draft' and 'Completed' tabs
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 separates work in flight, unfinished drafts and finished notifications, and DR1 said drafts must not lose their home on the list. The tabs are MoJ sub navigation on the animals frontend's own list, each a link that loads the page, over the animals backend's list, which gains category and tab filters and the 'In progress' count. A notification being amended stays in 'In progress'.
acceptanceCriteria: The live animals list shows three tabs, 'In progress', 'Draft' and 'Completed', as MoJ sub navigation, each a link that loads the list with that tab chosen, with or without JavaScript. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-037, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-038; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-061; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-099, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-100)

Opening the list with no tab chosen, or with an unknown tab, shows the 'In progress' tab selected; following a tab link drops any search and sort. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-038-m1; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-042; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p3-036; conflict c-251)

'In progress' lists submitted and action-required notifications, 'Draft' lists drafts, and 'Completed' lists completed notifications, so a draft never appears under 'In progress' and a submitted notification never under 'Draft'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-039; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-073, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-075; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-050; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p3-034)

A notification being amended is listed under 'In progress' with its yellow 'Amending' tag and its Resume, 'Copy as new', 'Cancel amendment' and Delete actions. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-046, repo-frontend-p3-111; trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p2-035, trace-animals-fit-p2-047; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p3-031; conflict c-165)

Only the 'In progress' tab shows a count, in bold brackets, such as 'In progress (2)', matching the notifications it lists; 'Draft' and 'Completed' show no count, even when selected. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-037; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-043; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-062)

Under the tabs the cards sit under an h3 naming the tab: 'Notifications in progress', 'Draft notifications' or 'Completed notifications'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-040; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-044, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-055, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-057; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-063)

A live animals notification whose record holds no category is still listed on the live animals list under its tab. (repo:backend repo-backend-p3-013; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-029; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-085)
notes: Combines the tab links, membership, amending placement, count, h3 and the list API's category and tab filters: one control over one query.

The tab parameter's name and values are the animals frontend's (c-251). Completed notifications cannot exist until the authorities' outcome feed (req-1082, blocked row), so 'Completed' is proven to hold none of the other statuses. That following a tab also drops the additional filters is proven in the additional-filters row, which adds them.
req-1099's germinal category filter is observed in the germinal rows, once a germinal notification exists; here it is proven by a record with no category staying on the live animals list.
Plants' tabs (req-2034) wait on trade-imports-plants-backend in the blocked plants row.

rows.title: The live animals list's search and sort become one form that really searches and sorts
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 lays the list out in one column and puts search and sort in one form with one submit control. The afternoon ruling makes it one GET form whose icon-only submit button searches and sorts on the server, so it works without JavaScript. Today's search matches only one exact, whole reference, so the search becomes a real keyword search over reference, commodity, consignee and consignor. The sort offers three orderings and is applied for real, with a tie-breaker so paging is stable.
acceptanceCriteria: On the live animals list the search and sort sit in one column above the tabs inside the 'Notifications' section, with no 'Filter notifications' heading and no separate filter column beside the results. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-009, repo-frontend-p3-010; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-045; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p3-013; conflict c-167)

The search field is labelled 'Search by' with the hint 'Keyword, notification number, commodity, consignee or consignor'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-027; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-039, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-040; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-046)

The search is submitted by a real submit button that shows only a magnifying-glass icon and whose accessible name is 'Search'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-027; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-047; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-097; conflict c-299)

Searching lists every notification whose reference number, commodity, consignee or consignor contains the searched text, ignoring case and surrounding spaces: part of a consignee's name finds that notification, and a lower-case part of a reference finds it. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-027; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-040; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-022; repo:backend repo-backend-p3-010, repo-backend-p3-011; ruling:sam-2026-10-07 ruling-sam-2026-10-07-p1-010; conflict c-162)

Search and sort are one GET form to the list's own address, submitted by the search button; it keeps the current tab (unless 'In progress') and the current page (when above 1), so the result stays on that tab. Changing the sort select submits nothing by itself, and the list has no 'Update sort' button. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-036; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-058; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-097; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-058; conflict c-299)

The sort select is labelled 'Sort by:' and offers exactly 'Newest first', 'Oldest first' and 'Arrival date', in that order, with no 'Select one' option. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-028; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-046, document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-048; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-026, repo-frontend-p3-027; conflict c-161)

'Newest first' lists the most recently created notification first, 'Oldest first' the earliest created first, and 'Arrival date' the latest arrival date first; with no sort chosen the list is in arrival date order, newest first, with 'Arrival date' selected, and the chosen option stays selected after the page reloads. (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-060; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-047; repo:backend repo-backend-p3-006, repo-backend-p3-007; ruling:sam-2026-10-07 ruling-sam-2026-10-07-p1-010; conflict c-161)

Paging through a sorted list in which several notifications share the sorted date, such as drafts with no arrival date, shows every notification exactly once across the pages. (repo:backend repo-backend-p3-008, repo-backend-p3-009; trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p2-092; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p3-057)

The k6 journey run against the stack still searches the live animals list for its notification by reference and finds the submitted notification's reference, passing every check. (repo:perftests repo-perftests-p1-068, repo-perftests-p1-069; conflict c-225)

rows.title: The live animals list has 'Additional filters' for arrival date, date range and status
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 keeps the extra filters out of the way until the trader needs them. The afternoon ruling builds them inside the one GET form from GOV.UK details, radios and a select, with an MoJ date picker at each end of the date range. The prototype's filters are inert, so the real list applies them through the animals backend's list, and a date it cannot use is answered with an error rather than ignored.
acceptanceCriteria: Inside the search form the live animals list has an 'Additional filters' disclosure, closed when the list first loads and open whenever an arrival-date, date-range or status filter is set. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-030; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-049; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-054; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-101; conflict c-299)

The additional filters have a 'By arrival date' column of small radios 'Today', 'Tomorrow' and 'Next 7 days'; choosing one and searching lists only notifications arriving in that range, and the choice stays checked. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-031; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-050; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-055, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-060; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-001; conflict c-162)

The additional filters have a 'By date range' column with the hint 'For example, 27/3/2026' and two MoJ date pickers, 'Start date' and 'End date', each a plain text field without JavaScript; searching lists only notifications arriving between the two dates, and the entered dates are kept. (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-051, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-052; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-056, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-057, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-121; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-101, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-102)

With JavaScript, each date picker offers a 'Choose date' calendar that opens on the current month with weeks starting on Monday. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-057; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-101)

Searching with a start date that cannot be read as a date shows a GOV.UK error summary and an inline error 'Enter a real start date'; an unreadable end date shows 'Enter a real end date'; an end date before the start date shows 'End date must be the same as or after the start date'. Each time 'Additional filters' is open, the entered text stays in the pickers, and the list is shown without the date-range filter. (ruling:sam-2026-10-07 ruling-sam-2026-10-07-p1-010; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-102; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p2-047; conflict c-166)

The additional filters have a 'Status' select offering exactly 'Select one', 'Action required', 'Submitted' and 'Completed'; choosing a status and searching lists only notifications in it, and the choice stays selected. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-035; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-053; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-058; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-024)
Following a tab link drops any additional filter as well as the search and sort. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-038-m1; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-100)
notes: Combines the disclosure, the three filter columns, the date validation and the list API's status and arrival-date filters: one section of one form over one query. No custom JavaScript: GOV.UK details, radios and select and the MoJ date picker, which the animals frontend already has.

The 'Action required' option lists what the animals backend records as 'Submitted action required' (inc-113); until that lands it lists nothing, and 'Completed' lists nothing until the authorities' outcome feed exists (req-1082, blocked row). Both options render and filter now. The prototype's lack of date validation is overruled (c-166).
Proves the half of req-1058 the tabs row cannot: following a tab drops the filters this row adds.

rows.title: The lists page 8 at a time with numbered pages, and lose the results line and empty messages
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 pages every list 8 at a time with numbered pagination, clamps the page so a stale address never shows an empty list, and shows no results count and no empty-state message. Because the real search and filters apply, page links keep them. Plants' list takes the numbered pagination and loses its results line and empty messages in the same increment; its page size waits on the plants backend.
acceptanceCriteria: The live animals list shows 8 notifications a page. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-041; repo:backend repo-backend-p3-005; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-036; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-092)

A list of more than one page shows GOV.UK pagination with numbered page links, a 'Previous' link from page 2 and a 'Next' link before the last page; a list of one page, or no results, shows no pagination. This holds on the live animals list and on plants' list. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-042; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-033, repo-frontend-p3-035; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-033, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-034; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-096)

Opening the live animals list at a page number below 1 or not a number shows page 1, and at a page past the last shows the last page; plants' list keeps doing the same. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-041; repo:backend repo-backend-p3-004; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-032-m1; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-035)

On the live animals list every page link keeps the tab (unless 'In progress'), the sort (unless the default), the search text and every additional filter, so page 2 of a filtered list is still filtered. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-031, repo-frontend-p3-034; ruling:sam-2026-10-07 ruling-sam-2026-10-07-p1-010; trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p2-064; conflict c-163)

Neither the live animals list nor plants' list shows a results count: no 'Showing 1 Result', 'Showing S to E of T Results', 'Showing N of T Results' or 'No Results' line. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-044; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-019, repo-frontend-p3-020; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-022, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-023; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-096; conflict c-167)

A search or filter that matches nothing shows an empty list with no message, on the live animals list and on plants' list: 'No notifications found' no longer appears. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-045; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-021; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-021)

A tab or list with no notifications shows an empty list with no message, on the live animals list and on plants' list: 'You have not started any notifications in this session.' no longer appears, in English or Welsh. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-045; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-022, repo-frontend-p3-023; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-038; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-096; conflict c-300)

sources.ref: pagination and empty states (prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-041, p13-042, p13-044, p13-045)
dashboard pagination and results line (repo-frontend-p3-019 to p3-023, p3-031 to p3-036)
plants dashboard pagination and results line (repo-plantsfrontend-p3-021 to p3-023, p3-033 to p3-035, p3-038)

notes: Combines page size, numbered pagination, out-of-range pages, page links keeping the list's state, and the three removed lines: they all sit below the cards and are proven with the same multi-page set-up. Depends on the search-and-sort and additional-filters rows, since page links carry what they add.

Plants' page size of 8 (req-2035) waits on trade-imports-plants-backend in the blocked plants row; plants' numbered pagination is built on whatever page size the plants backend serves. The prototype's page links dropping the search and filters are overruled (c-163).

rows.title: The lists' success banner is titled 'Success', on the live animals list and on plants' list
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 uses one success banner titled 'Success'; the message is set by the action that sent the trader back. The 9 October ruling keeps the flag on the redirect, such as after a delete, and the afternoon ruling gives plants' banner the same title. The new wording goes in each list feature's own copy, because the shared notificationActions wording is used by other pages and is never reworded in place.
acceptanceCriteria: After deleting a notification, the live animals list shows a GOV.UK success notification banner with role alert, titled 'Success', carrying the delete's message. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-020; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-062, repo-frontend-p3-063; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-101; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-093; conflict c-252)

After deleting a plants notification, plants' list shows the same success banner titled 'Success'. (repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-066, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-076; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-071)

The pages that share today's action wording, such as the delete and cancel-amendment pages, still read as they do today: the new 'Success' title is the lists' own wording. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-067, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-069)

With Welsh chosen, the banner's title shows its Welsh version, marked as a machine draft that ships only once a translator signs it off. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-064, repo-frontend-p3-065; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-069)
notes: The banner's message is the action's own: the delete row (inc-126) sets plants' 'Notification has been deleted' (req-2032). Depends on inc-129 and inc-126.

Kept as they are (already met): the banner does not dismiss itself (req-1088, c-006), and the stale-action and 'There is a problem' banners (req-1089). req-1087 (a held, show-once message) is out of scope (c-252): the flag on the redirect stays.
Today's 'Notification copied' banner is never reached, so only the delete is proven.

rows.title: After a delete, plants' list's banner reads 'Notification has been deleted'
rows.detail: The afternoon ruling gives plants' delete banner the message 'Notification has been deleted' in the same increment as the animals delete landing. The wording goes in plants' dashboard feature's own copy, leaving the shared notificationActions wording as it is.
acceptanceCriteria: After deleting a plants notification, plants' list shows a success banner whose message reads 'Notification has been deleted'. (repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-066, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-067; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-070; conflict c-252)

With Welsh chosen, the message shows its Welsh version, marked as a machine draft that ships only once a translator signs it off. (repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-076; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-069)
Other plants pages that use today's shared action wording still read as they do today. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-067, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-069)
notes: Draft for merging into inc-126 (the delete message on each set's own list), which already holds req-2032 beside the manage-notifications area's delete requirements: the same delete walk proves them. The combiner keeps inc-126's id and its repos and dependencies (inc-110, inc-120, inc-121, inc-125) and merges these criteria into it.
The 'Success' title is inc-140's (req-1086).

rows.title: 'Use template' on the live animals list
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 offers starting from a saved template from each animals category list. The templates ruling keeps the button on the list, going to the templates page without a category. Plants has no templates, so plants' list has no 'Use template' button.
acceptanceCriteria: The live animals list has a secondary 'Use template' button beside 'Create new'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-023; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-041; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-087)

Following 'Use template' opens the Manage templates page, with no category chosen. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-023; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-041, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-079; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates ruling-sam-2026-10-09-templates-p1-012)
Plants' list has no 'Use template' button. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-127, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-128; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates ruling-sam-2026-10-09-templates-p1-052)
openQuestions: Which page 'the templates page' is. Default: the Manage templates page the split-off type-question-and-templates theme builds (its inc-151); the button is a link to wherever that page lives.
notes: The button sits on the list's own feature folder, not in the templates feature the type-question-and-templates theme took, so it stays here. It is observable only once Manage templates exists, so it waits on that theme's inc-151 through externalDependsOn, kept as it was.
The germinal list's 'Use template' half of req-1038 is proven by the germinal list row (inc-141), which copies this list once this row has landed.

rows.title: The live animals list's Summary shows 'Action needed' and 'Status updated' glance cards
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 puts what needs the trader's attention at the top of each category list, with live counts that agree with the drill-down pages. The afternoon ruling counts these Summary cards as the INS dashboard's summary information, blocked until its requirements firm up.
acceptanceCriteria: The live animals list has an h2 'Summary' with two glance cards: 'Action needed' with 'Tasks requiring your attention' and a 'View tasks' link to the action-needed page for the category, and 'Status updated' with 'Changes in the past 24 hours' and a 'View updates' link to the changes page for the category. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-024; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-036 to prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-038; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-042 to trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-044)

The 'Action needed' card's count is the number of the category's notifications showing the 'Action required' tag, and matches the list its link opens. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-025, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-069; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p3-031; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-123; conflict c-149)
openQuestions: Blocked: the INS dashboard's requirements must firm up (Sam, 9 October; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p3-075, p3-078; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates p1-003 to p1-009). Who: Sam and the people the INS dashboard's requirements are agreed with. Once they exist, this summary information is re-distilled, and what the Summary shows, where its counts come from and which drill-downs it links to are decided then.
notes: Nothing in the reframed list depends on this row (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p3-099). Repos are the animals backend, animals frontend and tests, because the list it sits on stays in the animals frontend; re-check when it is re-distilled. DR2.1's fixed glance numbers are overruled (c-148).

rows.title: Cards show the authorities' outcomes: delayed, completed, inspection, their actions and the status-updated count
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 shows on the list what the authorities decide after submission: a delayed notification with its reason, a completed notification in the 'Completed' tab, an inspection warning, and 'Copy as new' and 'View' on cards in those statuses. None of these outcomes reaches the service today, so the row waits on the authorities' case system; the 'Status updated' count also waits on the INS dashboard's requirements.
acceptanceCriteria: A delayed notification shows a 'Delayed' tag on an error card with the reason for the delay, never the prototype's placeholder 'Error message'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-052, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-065)

A notification the authorities have finished with shows the status 'Completed', as plain styled text rather than a tag, and is listed in the 'Completed' tab. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-061; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-068; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p3-032; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-070, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-071)

A notification chosen for inspection shows an extra 'Inspection' fact with a 'Required' tag at the end of the card's second row. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-054; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-069)

A card in a delayed or completed status, or action required with no status-driven set of its own, offers 'Copy as new' then 'View', and View opens the notification's review page. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-047 to prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-049; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-048; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-054)

The 'Status updated' glance card's count is the number of the category's notifications whose status changed in the past 24 hours, and matches the list its link opens. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-025, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-069; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-123)
openQuestions: Blocked: the authorities' case system (PIMS Dynamics) must send post-submission outcomes (action required with its reason, inspection required, delayed, completed) back to the notification record. Who: the PIMS Dynamics integration owners must provide that outcome feed; until they do, no notification reaches these statuses and none of this can be built or observed.

Blocked as well, for the 'Status updated' count (req-1735): the INS dashboard's requirements must firm up (Sam, 9 October; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p3-078, p3-080). Who: Sam and the people those requirements are agreed with; the count is re-distilled with the summary information.
Whether plants' card follows the 'Completed' status is decided when it unblocks (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p3-065, p3-066).
notes: Keeps every requirement the PIMS outcome feed blocks apart, so the list rows build now. Once unblocked, the animals backend's record takes the outcomes (statuses are only ever added, p2-070) and the animals frontend's card, tabs and status filter pick them up.

rows.title: Plants' list tabs, eight a page, search, sort and filters, once the plants backend can query them
rows.detail: The afternoon ruling gives plants' list the same tabs, paging and search, sort and filters as the live animals list, but each needs trade-imports-plants-backend, outside this programme, to query plants notifications by status, page size, keyword and arrival date. They wait together, and plants' list keeps today's search, sort and paging meanwhile.
acceptanceCriteria: Plants' list has 'In progress', 'Draft' and 'Completed' tabs with the same count, subheadings and status grouping as the live animals list. (repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-019, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-032; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-096; conflict c-302)
Plants' list shows 8 notifications a page. (repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-024, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-025; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-096; conflict c-302)

Plants' list has the live animals list's one 'Search by' GET form with its hint and icon-only search button, a keyword search over the reference, commodity and consignor, the three sorts with no 'Update sort' button, the 'Additional filters', and page links that keep them. (repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-019; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-039, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-097)

sources.ref: plants dashboard list query (repo-plantsfrontend-p3-019, p3-024, p3-025, p3-032, p3-036)

openQuestions: Blocked: trade-imports-plants-backend, outside this programme, must let plants' list query plants notifications by status for the tabs and their counts, ask for a page size of 8, and search by keyword, status and arrival date with the new sorts (the plants read model, deferred.md; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p3-072 to p3-074, p3-097). Who: the plants backend's owners. Until then plants' list keeps today's search, sort and paging (req-2037).
notes: One row for the three plants list behaviours that wait on the same plants backend change, kept apart from the rows that build now. Recorded in deferred.md under ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p3-073.

rows.title: The germinal products set's root renders its own copy of the reframed list
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 gives each category of animal notification its own list. The afternoon ruling builds the germinal list as the germinal set's own copy of the reframed live animals list at the germinal set root in the animals frontend, instead of sending the trader to an INS list. It shows only germinal products notifications, and its 'Create new' starts a germinal notification in the germinal set.
acceptanceCriteria: Opening the germinal products set's root shows its own notification list, not a redirect: the browser title 'Dashboard - Import notification service - GOV.UK', the caption 'Dashboard' and the h1 'Germinal products'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-015, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-021; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-103, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-104; conflict c-314)

The germinal list has the same 'Use template', search, sort, additional filters, tabs, numbered paging and success banner as the live animals list, each submitting to and linking within the germinal list's own address. (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-061; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-078, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-079, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-081; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-104; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates ruling-sam-2026-10-09-templates-p1-012)

Pressing 'Create new' on the germinal list starts a germinal products notification with status Draft in the germinal products set and lands on that set's first journey page. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-015; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-102; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-104; conflict c-251)

The germinal list shows only germinal products notifications: a live animals notification, or one whose record holds no category, never appears on it, and a germinal notification just started appears on it. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-017; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-029; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-105)
notes: Copies the live animals list's feature folder into the germinal set, as the germinal set's other pages are copied. The animals backend's category filter is built in the tabs row (inc-135); the category stored on create is inc-176's.

Depends on inc-176 (the germinal set exists and stores its category) and on every live animals list row it copies, now including 'Use template' (inc-196) and the 'Success' banner (inc-140): the germinal list's 'Use template' is the germinal half of req-1038, which sits in inc-196. No Summary: it is blocked with inc-139.
The INS germinal list and its 'Create new' are not built in this programme (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p3-108); the morning ruling's redirect of the set root to an INS list is overruled (c-314).

rows.title: Germinal products notifications on their own list, with their own card facts
rows.detail: A trader looking at one category must not see another's notifications. The animals backend's list returns each notification's category and quantity, and for germinal products its packages and each line's species and product type, so the germinal cards say what is coming in the germinal way, and the live animals list leaves germinal notifications out.
acceptanceCriteria: A germinal products notification never appears on the live animals list, not even when its reference is searched. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-015, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-017; repo:backend repo-backend-p3-013; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-023, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-029; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-112)

A germinal products notification's card shows its quantity as 'Number of packages', from the notification's package count. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-058; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-064; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-082; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-105)

A germinal products notification's card shows the commodity as the species then the product type, separated by a comma, such as 'Cattle, Semen'. (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-063; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-083; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-105)

A germinal card whose notification has no package count, species or product type yet shows 'Not applicable' for that fact, so a missing fact never breaks the list. (repo:backend repo-backend-p3-015, repo-backend-p3-016, repo-backend-p3-017; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-090)

sources.ref: list item (repo-backend-p3-013, p3-015 to p3-017, p3-078)

notes: Covers req-1098 (the list item's full shape): its germinal facts can only be shown once a germinal notification with species, product type and packages exists, so it sits with the cards that show them; the live half (number of animals, commodity name) is what inc-130 shows.
Depends on inc-130 and inc-141, and on the germinal Commodity details row (inc-017), which first stores the package count the card shows.

rows.title: Each set creates its drafts with its own category
rows.detail: The 9 October ruling has each set pass its category when it creates a draft, so a germinal notification reaches the germinal list and not the live animals list. A record with no category still counts as live animals, so older drafts stay on the live animals list.
acceptanceCriteria: A notification started from the live animals list is stored with the category live animals and appears on the live animals list. (repo:backend repo-backend-p3-015; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-029, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-030)

A notification started in the germinal products set is stored with the category germinal products and never appears on the live animals list. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-029, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-030)
notes: Draft for merging into inc-176 (the germinal set's first row), which already holds req-1856 and req-1857 with the category on the record (req-1884 to req-1886): one backend field, one create path. The combiner keeps inc-176's id, repos, gate and dependencies and merges these criteria into it.

That a germinal notification then appears on the germinal list is proven by inc-141, which depends on this row; here it is observed as missing from the live animals list, whose category filter the tabs row (inc-135) builds, so this row depends on inc-135 as well as inc-129 and this row stays observable before the germinal list lands.
